This system can be written as

$$
[\begin{aligned}0 & 7 \\ 2 & 3\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}5 \\ -1\end{aligned}].
$$

To find the solution, we need to calculate the inverse of the coefficient matrix 
$A=[\begin{aligned}0 & 7 \\ 2 & 3\end{aligned}].$
This gives

$$
\begin{aligned}{A}^{-1} & =\frac{1}{0\cdot 3-2\cdot 7}[\begin{aligned}3 & -7 \\ -2 & 0\end{aligned}] \\  & =-\frac{1}{14}[\begin{aligned}3 & -7 \\ -2 & 0\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

We can now represent the solution to this system as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}x & ={A}^{-1}b \\  & =-\frac{1}{14}[\begin{aligned}3 & -7 \\ -2 & 0\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}5 \\ -1\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
